title: Hearty Uruguayan Vialone Nano Rice Pilaf
description: A briny and shaggy Uruguayan dish featuring Vialone Nano rice, cooked to perfection using sous vide method, this low carb friendly pilaf is a must try, the monsoon season calls for a hearty meal like this
instructions: Preheat the sous vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the rinsed Vialone Nano rice, chicken broth, olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the peeled and deveined shrimp to the bowl and stir gently to combine.
Transfer the rice mixture to a sous vide bag and seal the bag.
Place the sealed bag in the preheated sous vide machine and cook for 45 minutes.
Remove the bag from the machine and let it cool for a few minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve the pilaf hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
